metadata.title: filterCollisions() O(n²) Unbounded Array Growth — Browser DoS via Crafted Screen Response

sources: ApplinX REST API GetScreenResponse transformations[].regionsToHide[] (server-controlled rectangle coordinates)
transformations: initTree() — all rectangles inserted into RBush spatial index
filterCollisions() — outer loop reads dynamic fields.length
splitField() returns [f1, f2] — two new fields with updated column positions
fields.concat([f1, f2]) — grows fields array, queues new fields for O(n²) cascade
sinks: JavaScript event loop — blocked by 500,000+ iterations for 1000 rectangles
Browser memory — ~1GB+ Field object allocations at scale

privilege_boundary.start_privilege: ApplinX backend (compromised) or MITM on REST channel

impact.description: Browser tab freeze for 10-60 seconds with ~500K iterations for 1000 rectangles. Scanner stated 'linear' growth — investigation confirms O(n²) (~250x underestimate). In critical business workflows (banking, healthcare terminals), tab freeze has significant operational impact. Chains with VULN-006 (null crash) in AC-004.

prerequisites: Compromised ApplinX REST backend or MITM on unencrypted REST channel
Craft GetScreenResponse with many overlapping transformation rectangles

remediation.fix_approach: Add MAX_FIELDS guard in filterCollisions() (e.g., 10000 fields). Replace fields.concat([f1, f2]) with fields.push(f1, f2) for O(1) append. Add MAX_RECTS limit in initTree() to reject pathologically large inputs.

history.note: filterCollisions() appends split results to array during iteration; server-sent overlapping rectangles cause linear array growth (DoS)
Confirmed O(n²) growth — Scanner's 'linear' claim was wrong (~250x underestimate). ~500K iterations for 1000 rectangles. Upgraded from MEDIUM to HIGH. Part of AC-004 DoS chain with VULN-006.
